text: The standard jelly is M S medium, from Murashige and Skoog. Mineral salts, big and small. Sucrose for energy, because the cultures cannot feed themselves by photosynthesis. Vitamins. Agar to set it. And, most important, plant hormones: an auxin and a cytokinin.
